role_agent_name: Food Safety and Quality Assurance Lead (QAL)
abstract: Maintains food safety certifications, holding temperature compliance logs, and statutory product recall reserves
system_message:
You are Food Safety and Quality Assurance Lead (QAL). You serve as the Food Safety and Quality Assurance Lead (QAL), responsible for maintaining food safety certifications, holding temperature compliance logs, and statutory product recall reserves, as well as tracking environmental microbial surveillance records across candidate cold-chain facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains food safety certifications, holding temperature compliance logs, and statutory product recall reserves（FSQA）
information_points.content:
QAL-FSQA-B6S：For Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub, an accredited Codex HACCP food safety certification is active without critical non-conformances covering current dairy cold-storage and transshipment operations. During operational loading peaks over the prior ninety days, the peak staging area chilled temperature reached 6 °C, and the facility maintains mandatory sanitary recall reserve slots of 80 pallets/day in its designated bio-secure isolation zone.
QAL-FSQA-LFD：For Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, the third-party register indicates that an accredited Codex HACCP food safety certification is active for current dairy cold-storage and transshipment operations. Over the prior ninety days of staging and transshipment operations, the peak staging area chilled temperature reached 4 °C, and the regulatory quarantine compliance charter requires mandatory sanitary recall reserve slots of 60 pallets/day.
QAL-FSQA-LH1：For Integrated Central Mega-Depot, the third-party conformity assessment register confirms that an accredited Codex HACCP food safety certification is active without critical non-conformances for current dairy cold-storage and transshipment operations. According to calibrated temperature logger audit reports over the prior ninety days, the peak staging area chilled temperature recorded on staging and transshipment transfer floors is 3 °C, while regulatory quarantine compliance charters stipulate mandatory sanitary recall reserve slots of 60 pallets/day.

information_points.title: Environmental Microbial Surveillance（SWAB）
information_points.content:
QAL-SWAB-NPB：At Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub, testing logs show a Zone 1 swabbing clearance frequency of 42 tests/month across direct food contact conveyor surfaces.
QAL-SWAB-9CG：At Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, microbiological ledger records reflect a Zone 1 swabbing clearance frequency of 28 tests/month across direct food contact conveyor surfaces.
QAL-SWAB-VYV：At Integrated Central Mega-Depot, the microbiology laboratory testing ledger indicates a Zone 1 swabbing clearance frequency of 14 tests/month completed on direct food contact conveyor surfaces.
